source_text: Recapitulatio spiritalis: oculos columbae — intelligentia spiritalis; cubile — corpus fructuosum; cedrus/cypressus — doctrina et vita imputribilis; flos/lilium — Christus humilibus; malum — dulcedo Verbi; cella — mysteria; ordo caritatis; hiems vitiorum et ver virtutum; petra — secretum Verbi; vulpes — cogitationes et haereses pusillae capiendae.
pass_a_gloss: Recapitulation spiritual: eyes of-dove — understanding spiritual; couch — body fruitful; cedar/cypress — teaching and life incorruptible; flower/lily — Christ to-the-humble; apple — sweetness of-Word; cellar — mysteries; order of-charity; winter of-vices and spring of-virtues; rock — secret of-Word; foxes — thoughts and heresies little to-be-caught.
pass_b_english: Spiritual recapitulation: dove-eyes are spiritual understanding; the couch a fruitful body; cedar and cypress incorruptible teaching and life; flower and lily Christ for the lowly; the apple the Word’s sweetness; the cellar the mysteries; ordered charity; winter of vices and spring of virtues; the rock the Word’s secret; foxes little thoughts and heresies to be caught.
